title: Model cannot exceed 50 characters
why: Shows that the 50-character limit on Model is enforced.

steps.does: POST …/flight/aircraft with Name 'Long Model Jet', Model of 51 characters 'ABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJK', ManufacturingYear 2015

expect: Rejected with a validation error on Model length. No aircraft is created.
